procedural_matters: NED 1120 was represented by Esther de Jong.
GER 3161 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: The conditions were: wind 12-13 knots, 40 cm chop.
NED 1120 was sailing close-hauled on starboard tack approaching mark 1 for second rounding.
GER 3161 was sailing close-hauled on port tack on a converging course with NED 1120.
When boats were about 50cm apart, NED 1120 was aiming GER 3161 midship. At this point NED 1120 luffed abruptly and passed head to wind.
GER 3161 subsequently luffed, tacked onto starboard tack and continued sailing to the mark.
conclusions: GER 3161 on port failed to keep clear of NED 1120 on starboard, and broke RRS 10.
